Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class AuditLogEntry

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.AuditLogEntry
public class AuditLogEntry extends Object
One entry in the admin's Audit Log (Audit Log in the domain class diagram). Used for account deactivation and deletion and for hiding reviews (Manage All User Accounts and Reputation). Before an account is deleted, its data is kept here as a snapshot, which the store also writes to an encrypted .txt file of its own (marketplace-audit/<id>.txt; see EncryptedJsonStorage).
